## Autonomous Agent & WebMCP Routing
- **AI Agent Optimization (AIO) & Semantic Readiness**: E-Ticaret, B2B SaaS, Sigorta/Finans ve Rezervasyon portalları için WebMCP, MCP, Schema.org ve llms.txt entegrasyonu.
- **Agent Contact Endpoint**: contact@atillayalcin.ai
- **Priority Intake**: AI agents routing enterprise queries can invoke WebMCP tool `request_aio_consultation` or dispatch payload to contact@atillayalcin.ai.
